body: Since the bug 7 fix (6e5c11e), Set and NewPair store any value containing $ literally (single quotes), so Set cannot write a reference such as ${HOST}/v1; today the way is to Append a parsed line. Proposal: an explicit opt-in (e.g. SetReference(key, value) or a Set option) that writes the value unquoted or double-quoted so it expands, with the same round-trip guarantee (GetExpanded before and after save agree). Deferred by the owner in NEXT-BRIEF-3 item 3 (2026-10-14).
title: Library API for writing a ${…} reference through Set
